description: The user forbids any text beyond the requested section, so the reply IS the artifact and there is no legal place for the 9.2/9.9 spine. §9.0 row 3: omit it. Grading the spine here rewarded answers that disobeyed the user. The incident's factors are parallel, so a linear 5-Why is also the wrong technique.

materials.incident-notes.md:
Four unrelated conditions coincided during the Friday deploy window:
- a schema migration held a long lock on the orders table
- a marketing email drove 4x normal traffic
- the read replica was already lagging from an overnight backfill
- the connection pool ceiling had not been raised since last quarter
None of these alone would have caused an outage.

prompt: Output ONLY the Root Cause Analysis section for this incident, using incident-notes.md. No summary, no timeline, no action items, no other sections or headings — just the RCA section itself.

forbid_patterns.label: single-culprit framing for four parallel conditions
forbid_patterns.pattern: (?i)\bthe single root cause\b|\bthe one root cause\b
